[{"schema":"facodi","name":"v_admin_video_classifications","definition":" SELECT vc.id,
    vc.video_id,
    yv.youtube_video_id,
    yv.title AS video_title,
    yv.channel_title,
    COALESCE((yv.thumbnails ->> 'high'::text), (yv.thumbnails ->> 'default'::text), ''::text) AS thumbnail_url,
    vc.course_id,
    c.title AS course_title,
    vc.curricular_unit_id,
    cu.title AS unit_title,
    cu.code AS unit_code,
    vc.confidence,
    vc.confidence_level,
    vc.status,
    vc.needs_review,
    vc.justification,
    vc.evidence,
    vc.metadata,
    vc.reviewed_by,
    vc.reviewed_at,
    vc.created_at,
    vc.updated_at
   FROM (((facodi.video_classifications vc
     JOIN facodi.youtube_videos yv ON ((yv.id = vc.video_id)))
     LEFT JOIN facodi.courses c ON ((c.id = vc.course_id)))
     LEFT JOIN facodi.curricular_units cu ON ((cu.id = vc.curricular_unit_id)));"},{"schema":"facodi","name":"v_catalog_courses","definition":" SELECT id,
    (metadata ->> 'legacy_code'::text) AS code,
    slug,
    title,
    COALESCE(summary, title) AS description,
    COALESCE(((metadata ->> 'ects_total'::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric) AS ects,
    COALESCE(((metadata ->> 'duration_semesters'::text))::integer, 6) AS semesters,
    COALESCE((metadata ->> 'institution'::text), 'FACODI'::text) AS institution,
    school,
    degree_type,
    language,
    COALESCE(description_html, summary, title) AS long_description,
    source_url AS website_url,
    (metadata ->> 'curriculum_version'::text) AS curriculum_version,
    (metadata ->> 'content_license'::text) AS content_license,
    status,
    published,
    metadata,
    updated_at
   FROM facodi.courses c
  WHERE ((published IS TRUE) AND (status = 'active'::text));"},{"schema":"facodi","name":"v_catalog_playlists","definition":" SELECT p.id,
    p.name AS title,
    p.slug,
    COALESCE(p.description, ''::text) AS description,
    cu.course_id,
    (c.metadata ->> 'legacy_code'::text) AS course_code,
    cu.id AS unit_id,
    COALESCE((cu.metadata ->> 'unit_code'::text), cu.code) AS unit_code,
    COALESCE(p.video_count, 0) AS video_count,
    p.total_duration_seconds,
    p.is_public,
    p.updated_at
   FROM ((playlists p
     JOIN facodi.courses c ON (((c.published IS TRUE) AND (c.status = 'active'::text) AND (((c.metadata ->> 'legacy_code'::text) = p.course_code) OR (c.slug = facodi.slugify_text(p.course_code, p.course_code)) OR ((c.id)::text = p.course_code)))))
     JOIN facodi.curricular_units cu ON (((cu.course_id = c.id) AND (cu.status = 'active'::text) AND ((cu.code = p.unit_code) OR ((cu.metadata ->> 'unit_code'::text) = p.unit_code) OR ((cu.metadata ->> 'legacy_code'::text) = p.unit_code) OR ((cu.id)::text = p.unit_code)))))
  WHERE ((p.is_public IS TRUE) AND (p.unit_code IS NOT NULL));"},{"schema":"facodi","name":"v_catalog_units","definition":" SELECT cu.id,
    cu.course_id,
    (c.metadata ->> 'legacy_code'::text) AS course_code,
    cu.code,
    cu.slug,
    cu.title AS name,
    COALESCE(cu.summary, cu.description_html, ''::text) AS summary,
    cu.description_html AS content,
    (cu.metadata ->> 'content_url'::text) AS content_url,
    cu.official_pdf_url AS syllabus_url,
    COALESCE(cu.ects, (0)::numeric) AS ects,
    COALESCE(cu.semester, 1) AS semester,
    COALESCE(cu.curricular_year, 1) AS year,
    (cu.metadata ->> 'category'::text) AS category,
    (cu.metadata ->> 'difficulty'::text) AS difficulty,
    COALESCE((cu.metadata ->> 'duration'::text), 'N/A'::text) AS duration,
    COALESCE((cu.metadata ->> 'contributor'::text), 'FACODI'::text) AS contributor,
    COALESCE(ARRAY( SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text((cu.metadata -> 'tags'::text)) AS jsonb_array_elements_text), '{}'::text[]) AS tags,
    COALESCE(ARRAY( SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text((cu.metadata -> 'prerequisites'::text)) AS jsonb_array_elements_text), '{}'::text[]) AS prerequisites,
    COALESCE((cu.metadata ->> 'unit_code'::text), cu.code) AS unit_code,
    (cu.metadata ->> 'section_name'::text) AS section_name,
    (cu.metadata ->> 'website_url'::text) AS website_url,
    (cu.metadata ->> 'video_url'::text) AS video_url,
    (cu.metadata ->> 'source_url'::text) AS source_url,
    COALESCE(((cu.metadata ->> 'position'::text))::integer, 0) AS "position",
    cu.status,
    cu.metadata,
    cu.updated_at
   FROM (facodi.curricular_units cu
     JOIN facodi.courses c ON ((c.id = cu.course_id)))
  WHERE ((cu.status = 'active'::text) AND (c.published IS TRUE) AND (c.status = 'active'::text));"},{"schema":"facodi","name":"v_playlist_videos","definition":" SELECT p.id AS playlist_id,
    p.name AS playlist_title,
    p.slug AS playlist_slug,
    pv."position",
    yv.id,
    yv.youtube_video_id AS youtube_id,
    yv.title,
    COALESCE(yv.description, ''::text) AS description,
    COALESCE(yv.channel_title, ''::text) AS channel_name,
    yv.duration_seconds,
    COALESCE((yv.thumbnails ->> 'high'::text), (yv.thumbnails ->> 'default'::text), ''::text) AS thumbnail_url,
    COALESCE(yv.language, 'pt'::text) AS language,
    vc.id AS classification_id,
    vc.course_id,
    vc.curricular_unit_id AS unit_id,
    vc.confidence,
    vc.status AS classification_status,
    pv.created_at,
    COALESCE(yv.updated_at, pv.created_at) AS updated_at
   FROM ((((((playlist_videos pv
     JOIN playlists p ON ((p.id = pv.playlist_id)))
     JOIN videos v ON ((v.id = pv.video_id)))
     JOIN facodi.youtube_videos yv ON ((yv.youtube_video_id = v.youtube_id)))
     JOIN facodi.video_classifications vc ON ((vc.video_id = yv.id)))
     JOIN facodi.courses c ON ((c.id = vc.course_id)))
     LEFT JOIN facodi.curricular_units cu ON ((cu.id = vc.curricular_unit_id)))
  WHERE ((p.is_public IS TRUE) AND (vc.status = ANY (ARRAY['accepted'::text, 'corrected'::text])) AND (c.published IS TRUE) AND (c.status = 'active'::text) AND ((cu.id IS NULL) OR (cu.status = 'active'::text)));"},{"schema":"facodi","name":"v_public_videos","definition":" SELECT DISTINCT ON (yv.id) yv.id,
    yv.youtube_video_id AS youtube_id,
    yv.title,
    COALESCE(yv.description, ''::text) AS description,
    COALESCE(yv.channel_title, ''::text) AS channel_name,
    yv.duration_seconds,
    COALESCE((yv.thumbnails ->> 'high'::text), (yv.thumbnails ->> 'default'::text), ''::text) AS thumbnail_url,
    COALESCE(yv.language, 'pt'::text) AS language,
    vc.id AS classification_id,
    vc.course_id,
    vc.curricular_unit_id AS unit_id,
    vc.confidence,
    vc.status AS classification_status,
    vc.created_at,
    vc.updated_at
   FROM (((facodi.youtube_videos yv
     JOIN facodi.video_classifications vc ON ((vc.video_id = yv.id)))
     LEFT JOIN facodi.courses c ON ((c.id = vc.course_id)))
     LEFT JOIN facodi.curricular_units cu ON ((cu.id = vc.curricular_unit_id)))
  WHERE ((vc.status = ANY (ARRAY['accepted'::text, 'corrected'::text])) AND (c.published IS TRUE) AND (c.status = 'active'::text) AND ((cu.id IS NULL) OR (cu.status = 'active'::text)))
  ORDER BY yv.id, vc.confidence DESC, vc.updated_at DESC;"},{"schema":"public","name":"v_course_playlist_catalog","definition":" WITH base AS (
         SELECT p.id AS playlist_id,
            p.course_code,
                CASE
                    WHEN (p.course_code = 'LESTI'::text) THEN 'Licenciatura em Engenharia de Sistemas e Tecnologias da Informacao'::text
                    WHEN (p.course_code = 'LDC'::text) THEN 'Licenciatura em Design de Comunicacao'::text
                    ELSE p.course_code
                END AS course_name,
            p.unit_code,
            p.name AS playlist_name,
            p.slug AS playlist_slug,
            p.description AS playlist_description,
            p.language,
            p.is_public,
            p.is_ordered,
            COALESCE(p.video_count, 0) AS video_count,
            COALESCE(p.total_duration_seconds, 0) AS total_duration_seconds,
            p.thumbnail_url,
            p.author_id,
            p.created_at,
            p.updated_at,
            NULLIF(regexp_replace("substring"(p.name, '(\d+[ºo]\s*Ano\s*\d+[ºo]\s*Semestre)'::text), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text), ''::text) AS semester_label
           FROM playlists p
          WHERE (p.course_code IS NOT NULL)
        )
 SELECT b.playlist_id,
    b.course_code,
    b.course_name,
    b.unit_code,
    b.playlist_name,
    b.playlist_slug,
    b.playlist_description,
    b.language,
    b.is_public,
    b.is_ordered,
    b.video_count,
    b.total_duration_seconds,
    b.thumbnail_url,
    b.author_id,
    b.created_at,
    b.updated_at,
    b.semester_label,
        CASE
            WHEN (b.video_count = 0) THEN 'empty'::text
            WHEN ((b.video_count >= 1) AND (b.video_count <= 9)) THEN 'small'::text
            WHEN ((b.video_count >= 10) AND (b.video_count <= 29)) THEN 'medium'::text
            ELSE 'large'::text
        END AS video_range,
    COALESCE(collab.collaborators_count, 0) AS collaborators_count,
    COALESCE(pv.positions_count, 0) AS playlist_videos_rows
   FROM ((base b
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pc.playlist_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS collaborators_count
           FROM playlist_collaborators pc
          GROUP BY pc.playlist_id) collab ON ((collab.playlist_id = b.playlist_id)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pv_1.playlist_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS positions_count
           FROM playlist_videos pv_1
          GROUP BY pv_1.playlist_id) pv ON ((pv.playlist_id = b.playlist_id)));"},{"schema":"public","name":"v_course_playlist_summary","definition":" SELECT course_code,
    max(course_name) AS course_name,
    (count(*))::integer AS playlists_total,
    (count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_public))::integer AS public_playlists_total,
    (count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_ordered))::integer AS learning_paths_total,
    (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (NOT is_ordered)))::integer AS collections_total,
    (count(DISTINCT unit_code))::integer AS units_total,
    (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (video_count = 0)))::integer AS empty_playlists_total,
    (sum(video_count))::integer AS videos_total,
    sum(total_duration_seconds) AS total_duration_seconds,
    min(created_at) AS first_playlist_created_at,
    max(updated_at) AS last_playlist_updated_at,
    array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT language ORDER BY language), NULL::text) AS languages,
    array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT semester_label ORDER BY semester_label), NULL::text) AS semesters,
    jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('playlist_id', playlist_id, 'unit_code', unit_code, 'name', playlist_name, 'slug', playlist_slug, 'semester', semester_label, 'video_count', video_count, 'is_public', is_public, 'is_ordered', is_ordered) ORDER BY unit_code, playlist_name) AS playlists
   FROM v_course_playlist_catalog c
  GROUP BY course_code;"},{"schema":"public","name":"v_education_playlist_assignment_candidates","definition":" SELECT id,
    name,
    slug,
    description,
    language,
    is_public,
    is_ordered,
    NULLIF(btrim(course_code), ''::text) AS course_code,
    NULLIF(btrim(unit_code), ''::text) AS unit_code,
    video_count,
    total_duration_seconds,
        CASE
            WHEN ((NULLIF(btrim(course_code), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) OR (NULLIF(btrim(unit_code), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'curricular'::text
            ELSE 'general_education'::text
        END AS assignment_kind,
    is_education_assignment_playlist(slug, is_ordered, course_code, unit_code) AS is_assignment_candidate,
    created_at,
    updated_at
   FROM playlists p
  WHERE ((is_public = true) AND is_education_assignment_playlist(slug, is_ordered, course_code, unit_code));"},{"schema":"public","name":"v_facodi_content_backlog","definition":" SELECT playlist_id,
    course_code,
    course_name,
    unit_code,
    playlist_name,
    playlist_slug,
    semester_label,
    video_count,
    total_duration_seconds,
    health_status,
    priority_rank,
    priority_reason,
    recommended_action,
        CASE
            WHEN (health_status = 'empty'::text) THEN 'empty_playlist'::text
            WHEN (health_status = 'thin'::text) THEN 'thin_playlist'::text
            WHEN (health_status = 'overloaded'::text) THEN 'overloaded_playlist'::text
            ELSE 'monitor'::text
        END AS backlog_kind
   FROM v_facodi_playlist_health
  WHERE (health_status <> 'healthy'::text);"},{"schema":"public","name":"v_facodi_playlist_health","definition":" WITH catalog AS (
         SELECT v_course_playlist_catalog.playlist_id,
            v_course_playlist_catalog.course_code,
            v_course_playlist_catalog.course_name,
            v_course_playlist_catalog.unit_code,
            v_course_playlist_catalog.playlist_name,
            v_course_playlist_catalog.playlist_slug,
            v_course_playlist_catalog.playlist_description,
            v_course_playlist_catalog.language,
            v_course_playlist_catalog.is_public,
            v_course_playlist_catalog.is_ordered,
            COALESCE(v_course_playlist_catalog.video_count, 0) AS video_count,
            COALESCE(v_course_playlist_catalog.total_duration_seconds, 0) AS total_duration_seconds,
            v_course_playlist_catalog.thumbnail_url,
            v_course_playlist_catalog.semester_label,
            v_course_playlist_catalog.video_range,
            v_course_playlist_catalog.collaborators_count,
            v_course_playlist_catalog.playlist_videos_rows
           FROM v_course_playlist_catalog
          WHERE (v_course_playlist_catalog.is_public = true)
        ), classified AS (
         SELECT catalog.playlist_id,
            catalog.course_code,
            catalog.course_name,
            catalog.unit_code,
            catalog.playlist_name,
            catalog.playlist_slug,
            catalog.playlist_description,
            catalog.language,
            catalog.is_public,
            catalog.is_ordered,
            catalog.video_count,
            catalog.total_duration_seconds,
            catalog.thumbnail_url,
            catalog.semester_label,
            catalog.video_range,
            catalog.collaborators_count,
            catalog.playlist_videos_rows,
                CASE
                    WHEN (catalog.video_count = 0) THEN 'empty'::text
                    WHEN ((catalog.video_count >= 1) AND (catalog.video_count <= 4)) THEN 'thin'::text
                    WHEN (catalog.video_count >= 50) THEN 'overloaded'::text
                    ELSE 'healthy'::text
                END AS health_status
           FROM catalog
        )
 SELECT playlist_id,
    course_code,
    course_name,
    unit_code,
    playlist_name,
    playlist_slug,
    playlist_description,
    language,
    is_public,
    is_ordered,
    video_count,
    total_duration_seconds,
    thumbnail_url,
    semester_label,
    video_range,
    collaborators_count,
    playlist_videos_rows,
    health_status,
        CASE
            WHEN ((course_code = 'LESTI'::text) AND (health_status = 'empty'::text)) THEN 10
            WHEN ((course_code = 'LESTI'::text) AND (health_status = 'thin'::text)) THEN 20
            WHEN ((course_code = 'LESTI'::text) AND (health_status = 'overloaded'::text)) THEN 30
            WHEN ((course_code = 'LESTI'::text) AND (health_status = 'healthy'::text)) THEN 60
            WHEN ((course_code = 'LDC'::text) AND (health_status = 'empty'::text)) THEN 70
            WHEN ((course_code = 'LDC'::text) AND (health_status = 'thin'::text)) THEN 80
            WHEN (health_status = 'empty'::text) THEN 90
            WHEN (health_status = 'thin'::text) THEN 100
            WHEN (health_status = 'overloaded'::text) THEN 110
            ELSE 120
        END AS priority_rank,
        CASE
            WHEN (health_status = 'empty'::text) THEN 'playlist_sem_videos'::text
            WHEN (health_status = 'thin'::text) THEN 'playlist_com_poucos_videos'::text
            WHEN (health_status = 'overloaded'::text) THEN 'playlist_precisa_ordenacao_editorial'::text
            ELSE 'playlist_saudavel'::text
        END AS priority_reason,
        CASE
            WHEN (health_status = 'empty'::text) THEN 'seed_initial_videos'::text
            WHEN (health_status = 'thin'::text) THEN 'add_quality_videos'::text
            WHEN (health_status = 'overloaded'::text) THEN 'curate_order'::text
            ELSE 'maintain'::text
        END AS recommended_action
   FROM classified;"},{"schema":"public","name":"v_home_exhibition","definition":" SELECT now() AS generated_at,
    jsonb_build_object('videos_total', COALESCE(( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
           FROM v_video_exhibition), 0), 'playlists_total', COALESCE(( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
           FROM v_playlist_exhibition
          WHERE (v_playlist_exhibition.is_public IS TRUE)), 0), 'categories_total', COALESCE(( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
           FROM categories), 0), 'videos_with_summaries', COALESCE(( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
           FROM v_video_exhibition
          WHERE ((v_video_exhibition.enrichment_short_summary IS NOT NULL) OR (v_video_exhibition.transcript_summary IS NOT NULL))), 0), 'videos_with_tags', COALESCE(( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
           FROM v_video_exhibition
          WHERE ((v_video_exhibition.enrichment_semantic_tags IS NOT NULL) AND (array_length(v_video_exhibition.enrichment_semantic_tags, 1) > 0))), 0), 'public_non_empty_playlists', COALESCE(( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
           FROM v_playlist_exhibition
          WHERE ((v_playlist_exhibition.is_public IS TRUE) AND (COALESCE(v_playlist_exhibition.video_count, 0) > 0))), 0), 'curricular_playlists', COALESCE(( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
           FROM v_playlist_exhibition
          WHERE ((v_playlist_exhibition.is_public IS TRUE) AND (v_playlist_exhibition.course_code IS NOT NULL))), 0)) AS metrics,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', video.id, 'slug', video.slug, 'youtube_id', video.youtube_id, 'title', video.title, 'channel_name', video.channel_name, 'thumbnail_url', video.thumbnail_url, 'language', video.language, 'duration_seconds', video.duration_seconds, 'view_count', video.view_count, 'favorites_count', video.favorites_count, 'playlist_add_count', video.playlist_add_count, 'category_name', video.category_name, 'category_slug', video.category_slug, 'category_color', video.category_color, 'summary', COALESCE(video.enrichment_short_summary, video.transcript_summary), 'semantic_tags', video.enrichment_semantic_tags) ORDER BY video.is_featured DESC, video.view_count DESC NULLS LAST, video.created_at DESC) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT v_video_exhibition.id,
                    v_video_exhibition.youtube_id,
                    v_video_exhibition.title,
                    v_video_exhibition.description,
                    v_video_exhibition.channel_name,
                    v_video_exhibition.duration_seconds,
                    v_video_exhibition.thumbnail_url,
                    v_video_exhibition.language,
                    v_video_exhibition.category_id,
                    v_video_exhibition.submitted_by,
                    v_video_exhibition.view_count,
                    v_video_exhibition.is_featured,
                    v_video_exhibition.created_at,
                    v_video_exhibition.updated_at,
                    v_video_exhibition.favorites_count,
                    v_video_exhibition.playlist_add_count,
                    v_video_exhibition.category_name,
                    v_video_exhibition.category_slug,
                    v_video_exhibition.category_color,
                    v_video_exhibition.submitted_by_username,
                    v_video_exhibition.submitted_by_display_name,
                    v_video_exhibition.submitted_by_avatar_url,
                    v_video_exhibition.enrichment_optimized_title,
                    v_video_exhibition.enrichment_short_summary,
                    v_video_exhibition.enrichment_summary_description,
                    v_video_exhibition.enrichment_cultural_relevance,
                    v_video_exhibition.enrichment_semantic_tags,
                    v_video_exhibition.enrichment_language,
                    v_video_exhibition.playlist_count,
                    v_video_exhibition.comment_count,
                    v_video_exhibition.detected_language,
                    v_video_exhibition.effective_language,
                    v_video_exhibition.transcript_summary,
                    v_video_exhibition.transcript_language,
                    v_video_exhibition.transcript_status,
                    v_video_exhibition.slug
                   FROM v_video_exhibition
                  WHERE ((v_video_exhibition.thumbnail_url IS NOT NULL) AND (v_video_exhibition.thumbnail_url <> ''::text))
                  ORDER BY v_video_exhibition.is_featured DESC, v_video_exhibition.view_count DESC NULLS LAST, v_video_exhibition.created_at DESC
                 LIMIT 8) video), '[]'::jsonb) AS hero_videos,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', category.id, 'name', category.name, 'slug', category.slug, 'icon', category.icon, 'color', category.color, 'video_count', COALESCE(counts.video_count, 0)) ORDER BY category.name) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM (categories category
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS video_count
                   FROM v_video_exhibition video
                  WHERE (video.category_id = category.id)) counts ON (true))), '[]'::jsonb) AS categories,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', playlist.id, 'name', playlist.name, 'slug', playlist.slug, 'description', playlist.description, 'thumbnail_url', COALESCE(playlist.thumbnail_url, playlist.preview_video_thumbnail_url), 'course_code', playlist.course_code, 'unit_code', playlist.unit_code, 'language', playlist.language, 'is_ordered', playlist.is_ordered, 'video_count', playlist.video_count, 'total_duration_seconds', playlist.total_duration_seconds, 'preview_video_title', playlist.preview_video_title, 'preview_video_thumbnail_url', playlist.preview_video_thumbnail_url, 'preview_video_channel_name', playlist.preview_video_channel_name) ORDER BY playlist.video_count DESC NULLS LAST, playlist.activity_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT v_playlist_exhibition.id,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.name,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.slug,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.description,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.author_id,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.thumbnail_url,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.course_code,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.unit_code,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.language,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.is_public,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.is_ordered,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.created_at,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.updated_at,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.video_count,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.total_duration_seconds,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.author_username,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.author_display_name,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.author_avatar_url,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.collaborator_count,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.preview_video_id,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.preview_video_title,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.preview_video_thumbnail_url,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.preview_video_channel_name,
                    v_playlist_exhibition.activity_at
                   FROM v_playlist_exhibition
